card.title: Galaxy A127(exynos) Earpiece and Mic Not Working

source.title: Galaxy A127(exynos) Earpiece and Mic Not Working

claims.statement: Earpiece and main mic dead on Galaxy A127 after heavy drop or bending near the shield can be broken inner-layer traces between CPU and PMIC under the shield, even when FPC and earpiece diode readings are normal.
Signs are a dent at the shield, torn ground pad, and bubbling/delamination when the outer ground layer is scraped.

procedure: Inspect the shield area for impact damage and torn ground pad.
Scrape the outer ground layer; look for delamination.
Expose and pretin the second-layer audio traces to the PMIC.
Rebuild with fine jumper wire; clean; UV mask.
card.caveats: Specialist-level inner layer repair. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
